title: Acme Analytics pricing overview
text: Acme Analytics lists Pro at 95 USD per seat with 300000 included events and Enterprise at 165 USD per seat with 600000 included events. Enterprise annual commitments receive a 10 percent discount.

title: Acme Analytics SLA and service credits
text: Acme Enterprise advertises 99.95 percent uptime. Customers receive a 15 percent credit below 99.9 percent uptime and a 30 percent credit below 99.5 percent uptime. Acme Pro advertises 99.5 percent uptime with a 10 percent credit below 99.0 percent uptime.

title: Roadmap update: HIPAA beta and EU data residency
text: The public roadmap states that HIPAA support is in beta for a limited group of enterprise design partners later this year, while EU data residency is now generally available for enterprise customers.
